warrants.quote: At June 30, 2025, there are 14,374,969 Public Warrants and 9,763,333 Private Placement warrants outstanding.

Simultaneously with the closing of the IPO, PowerUp completed the private sale of 9,763,333 Private Placement warrants where each warrant allows the holder to purchase one share of the Company's Class A common stock at $ 11.50 per share.

next_catalyst.what: In vivo single-dose bioavailability/pharmacokinetic test (approx. eight volunteers) for Aspire's aspirin product, to establish criteria for an NDA
next_catalyst.quote: test in approximately the third quarter of 2026 for pharmokinetical validation of product properties, using approximately eight volunteers, and to establish criteria for an NDA with the FDA.
